name: The Dead Foundry

Landmark architecture occupies upper-middle band, from x=18% to 83% and y=6% to 57%; BASE OF ALL STRUCTURES ends at y=58%. Entire lower 40% of canvas must be COMPLETELY EMPTY TRANSPARENT, to accept a separate walkable ground plate. Holes, windows and space around silhouettes must also be truly transparent.
